statement: For every symmetric binary integer99-by-99 matrix A with zero diagonal and every integer row sum14, set R=A^2+A-12I-2J and M=R modulo3 over GF(3). If the whole nonzero unordered off-diagonal support graph of M has exactly12 edges, it is isomorphic to K2,6 or K6 with a perfect matching deleted. This is a necessary shape classification; neither shape is asserted realizable and no arbitrary-component or general12-exclusion/target conclusion follows.
